design.dns: shared 2D two-ring centre-free neighbour self-similarity on VGG 16x16 features, projected to 512 channels, zero-gated residual
design.combined_order: VGG -> DNS residual -> existing self attention -> existing cross attention -> Global Correlation
design.arms_are_independent: all start from the same pretrained base; no continuation from trained SA/CA; no contrastive loss or sampling/weighting change
design.training: same train split, shuffled image order, batch/steps, AdamW, coarse EPE + 2x correlation CE
design.within_arm_checkpoint: minimum validation coarse EPE, matching selected existing SA/CA protocol
design.between_arm_decision: final 512px EPE, actual first-window miss rate, >=64px GT region EPE and per-pair stability; coarse EPE alone insufficient
